page.layout: One printed title page, one column, centred; a library oval stamp at upper right and pencil shelf marks at the foot are not printed text and are left out.

main_text.l: In illustri BERNATUM Lycæo, SS. Theologiæ
Professore ordinario, Dignissimo, Fautore ac Præceptore
Ad diem 8. Februarii loco horisq; solitis.

page.notes: The Hebrew line "בשם שלשות הקדשה" is printed in Hebrew letters as on the scan. The ornament between the date line and the imprint is a printer's device, not text. The pencil marks "1.1", "b 78" and "A-4'894'868" are handwriting and shelf marks, left out. Text in "Ad diem 8." line: the abbreviation "q;" stands for -que as printed.
